findings.evidence: `FourierConvention.lean:75` sets `[NormedAddCommGroup W] [BorelSpace W]`, while `FourierConvention.lean:99` and `:112` call `charFun_isPositiveDefinite_of_star_eq_neg`/`charFun_isPositiveDefiniteKernel`; those source lemmas are declared at `CharFunPositiveDefinite.lean:46-52` and `:74-76` under `[SeminormedAddCommGroup E] [OpensMeasurableSpace E]`.
findings.fix: Move the two positive-definiteness lemmas out of the topology section, with variables like `[SeminormedAddCommGroup W] [InnerProductSpace ℝ W] [MeasurableSpace W] [OpensMeasurableSpace W] {ν : Measure W} [IsFiniteMeasure ν]`; keep only the continuity/package lemma in the normed second-countable section.
findings.issue: `fourierConventionCharFun_isPositiveDefinite_of_star_eq_neg` and `fourierConventionCharFun_isPositiveDefiniteKernel` are under `[NormedAddCommGroup W] [BorelSpace W]`; their proofs only use seminormed characteristic-function positivity, so this excludes the natural `SeminormedAddCommGroup`/`OpensMeasurableSpace` level already used nearby.

summary: The Fourier conversion lemmas are fine, but the positive-definiteness API is stated under unnecessary continuity-level hypotheses.
